POSE: run/S/16 RIGHT PRE-CONTACT, about to loop to frame01. RIGHT boot on image LEFT is forward toward viewer, heel only 4 pixels above virtual ground y92%, toe slightly lifted, knee soft. LEFT leg on image RIGHT trails with knee flexed and heel lifted behind. Pelvis/head nearly contact height, fixed head scale/camera. RIGHT brush hand stays back near hip, LEFT scroll hand remains forward at low chest. Shoulders and elbows connected. Strong asymmetrical running posture, next instant right heel contacts ground.
